hooks.command: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then if uv run --directory "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/meta" python -m harness.issue_duplicate_guard; then :; else rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 42 ]; then exit 2; else exit 1; fi; fi; fi
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then if uv run --directory "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/meta" python -m harness.commit_guard; then :; else rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 42 ]; then exit 2; else exit 1; fi; fi; fi

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then if uv run --directory "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/meta" python -m harness.commit_backstop; then :; else rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 42 ]; then exit 2; else exit 1; fi; fi; fi
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --directory "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/meta" python -m harness.answer_first_reminder || exit 1; fi
